excerpt.zh: 我们从[Root.GetName]上热带森林收集到的初始数据表明，这里有一些异常的东西。
excerpt.en: The initial data gathered from the tropical forests of [Root.GetName] indicate that something is out of the ordinary.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]上面的一些植物在自然选择中进化出了一套有效的自我防御措施。许多的树木和真菌都会释放出孢子，这些孢子对非植物生命来说具有非常强的酸性。还好，科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]发现了中和其中一些孢子的方法，让这颗星球上的森林不那么致命了！
texts.en: It appears that some of [From.GetName]'s flora has developed effective defense mechanisms through natural selection. Numerous trees and fungi exude spores that act like a powerful acidic on non-plant organisms. Thankfully Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has found a way to counteract some strands of these spores, making the planet's forests less threatening to us!
